text:
incident-bot: PAGER: 2479994321 | region: us-west-2 | symptom: cont-batch tail latency spike + KV cache page-ins. Alert rule: cont-batch_99p_latency > 4s for 5m. Escalating to oncall.

emily.r: I'm picking this up. seeing a pattern of sustained large batches and increasing kvcache residency. Not a CPU plateau, memory and swap climbing.

daniel.m: Any recent infra or model changes? I see a config diff landed this morning that increased max_batch_tokens for a dev experiment.

kai: Yep, I pushed a quick tweak to allow 12k tokens in a batch on canary to test long-context behavior. Intended for canary only but config-service label mismatch may have promoted it further.

lina_ops: Confirmed: config-service tracked a rollout from canary->staging at 10:03, then an automated promote job erroneously included prod pools at 10:12. It applied max_batch_tokens: 8192 and max_num_seqs: 56 in prod pools.

oncall_josh: Customer impact: several Hosted customers reported slow streaming and some gateway 504s. Dedicated tenants on us-west-2 hitting higher tail latencies.

emily.r: Logs from node i-0f4c: "kvcache_resident=6.7GB target=2.5GB; page_in_rate=3200pps; cont-batch: composed_batch_tokens=12000; seqs=52". Dump:

```
2026-03-15T23:02:11Z cont-batcher[pid=8892]: batch_tokens=12012 seqs=52 kvcache_size=6.7GB
2026-03-15T23:02:13Z kernel: <- swapd: reclaim pressure: high -> page-in 4096 pages
2026-03-15T23:02:15Z cont-batcher[pid=8892]: request id=xyz timeout streaming after 7.1s
```

daniel.m: That batch_tokens=12k exceeds previous safe envelope. KV cache was never stress-tested at that density; cache indexing and page tables are spiking.

support-bot: Suggested runbook: 1) pause promote job, 2) rollback config to last known good, 3) apply temporary eviction_threshold reduction, 4) re-route long-context sessions to degraded path.

kai: I'm rolling back the promote and reverting canary change. Applying hotfix config now to reduce max_batch_tokens to 4096 and max_num_seqs to 32.

emily.r: Please do staged rollouts. We'll watch kvcache size, swap rates, and cont-batch tail latency. Also enable additional logging of batch composition.

lina_ops: Executing rollback:
```
configctl rollback promote-job 2026-03-15-1012 && configctl apply contbatch-prod-rollback.yaml
```

ops-bot: ACTION: rollback started by kai at 2479994450. Notifying automation to throttle promotions.

oncall_josh: Canary observed improvement within 90s after rollback. Prod stepping down slowly as well. Memory falling back.

daniel.m: Note: a latent bug in KV cache compaction means eviction isn't keeping up under sudden large-batch churn. We'll need code fix but rollout rollback is mitigating.

emily.r: Short-term mitigations applied: eviction_threshold lowered, aggressive compaction enabled, and gateway rule to cap incoming batch_tokens per request to 5k.

kai: Gateway rule applied: max_request_tokens=5000. Command:
```
gwctl set-route --match "long-context" --max-tokens 5000
```

support-bot: Support update: Customers notified via status page; two tenants reported ~10 minutes of degraded streaming. Support docs updated.

lina_ops: Post-rollback metrics at 2479994720: kvcache resident trending down 60%, page-in rate back to baseline, cont-batch 99p latency fell under 500ms.

oncall_josh: I'll keep the incident open for another 45m to verify stability. Please record timeline and assign postmortem lead.

daniel.m: I'll own the postmortem. Preliminary RCA: unintended prod promotion of long-context config + KV cache compaction gap -> paging & tail latencies. Fixes: reject promotions without explicit env tag, add synthetic load tests for kvcache pressure, and backport compaction patch.

emily.r: Action items: 
- emergency: add gating on config-service to prevent canary->prod automatic promotes
- medium: tune kvcache compaction and add safe-limits for max_batch_tokens
- long: end-to-end tests that simulate token-dense batches

lina_ops: Setting incident state to mitigated if stable for 30m. Will update status page when mitigated.

ops-bot: INCIDENT LOG: mitigations applied and rollback completed. Assigned postmortem: /docs/incidents/2479994321-kvcache-config-promotion-rca.json (placeholder).

oncall_josh: Thanks everyone. Quick sync in 10 to capture notes. :pray:
